handoff_record.branch: claude/world-viewer (local; this session had read-only repo access, so it was delivered as a git bundle + patch for Joshua to push)
handoff_record.assignment: NLT World Engine — Vercel Viewer Design & Implementation (brief originally written for Kimi)
work_completed: Audited vercel/viewer, world-engine-godot builders, Images/Screenshots, state-feed contract and fixtures, Vercel project world-engine-viewer and the parallel feature/viewer-godot-world branch (PRs #123/#125).

Ported the Godot open-world builders to TypeScript (WorldGeometry, TerrainBuilder, WaterBuilder, SettlementBuilder + BuildingArchetypes + PortalMarker, VegetationBuilder) with the same seed, constants, RNG order and float32 rounding at decision points; building placement matches Godot captures building-for-building.
Loaded the four project-owned interior FBX levels with the same axis/unit conversion Godot's ufbx importer applies, and ported InteriorStyle so building N opens in colour scheme N.

Rebuilt vercel/viewer as a three.js spectator viewer: WorldView.cs camera (orbit/zoom/pan, follow), residents from the self-authored probe GLB with feed-gated walk cycle, name/state labels, building doorway affordance, scene selector, roster + inspector, event feed, minimap, replay transport with event markers, reduced motion, responsive mobile layout.

Added an explicit FeedSource boundary: ReplaySource (state-feed replay bundles, contract §9 validation, diagnostics) and LiveRelaySource (reports unavailable with the reason). UI labels every source; nothing is presented as live.
Kept the previous observer-trace viewer intact at trace.html.
Added scripts/sync-godot-assets.mjs so fixtures/resident/levels are copied from world-engine-godot at dev/build time instead of committed as copies.
blockers: No push access from this session (add_repo push was refused), so the branch could not be pushed and no Vercel preview could be built from it. Delivered as claude-world-viewer.bundle + .patch.
decisions_made: Rebuild the world from the engine's deterministic builders rather than approximate it or use screenshots (C# cannot be web-exported; screenshots carry Godot's UI).
three.js as the only runtime dependency; FBXLoader code-split.
Hide the 'Hermes' UE placeholder mesh in Personal_Level (InteriorStyle.cs misses it) so the viewer never shows a person the feed does not contain.

Live viewing only needs a FeedSource implementation for an authorised relay — the UI is already source-agnostic.
